Votre rôle:
Au sein de l'Agence Rhône-Alpes - Secteur Tertiaire, vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique qui possède une forte expertise dans le domaine des CMS et qui conçoit des solutions numériques innovantes pour ses clients.

Dans le cadre d'une démarche de veille technologique, l'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier les différentes philosophies de contribution dans Drupal et d'expérimenter l'intégration d'une intelligence artificielle générative éthique.

L'étude portera notamment sur :

- la contribution via un éditeur WYSIWYG ;
- la construction de contenus avec Paragraphs ;
- la mise en page avec Layout Builder ;
- l'import de contenus ;
- l'utilisation d'APIs ou de mécanismes d'automatisation.

Ces approches seront comparées avec et sans IA selon différents critères :

- expérience utilisateur ;
- qualité et temps de production ;
- avantages et limites ;
- coûts d'intégration et d'utilisation ;
- possibilités d'industrialisation ;
- impacts éthiques, sociaux et environnementaux.

L'objectif sera d'identifier les cas dans lesquels l'IA apporte une réelle valeur ajoutée, aussi bien pour les projets existants que pour la conception de nouvelles solutions destinées aux futurs clients.

Dans un CMS, la contribution ne se limite pas à la création de contenu. Elle dépend également de la manière dont le contributeur peut créer, structurer, organiser et publier ce contenu.

Drupal propose plusieurs modes de contribution, notamment :

- WYSIWYG : rédaction dans un éditeur de texte enrichi ;
- Paragraphs : assemblage de composants éditoriaux ;
- Layout Builder : construction de mises en page ;
- Import : intégration de contenus provenant d'une source externe ;
- API et automatisation : alimentation du site par des systèmes tiers.

Le stagiaire sera intégré à une équipe d'ingénieurs travaillant sur des solutions Drupal. Il étudiera ces différentes approches et expérimentera l'intégration d'une IA générative pour assister le contributeur, par exemple dans la rédaction, la reformulation, la structuration ou l'enrichissement des contenus.

L'IA devra être utilisée dans un cadre éthique et maîtrisé, en prenant en compte :

- la validation humaine ;
- la fiabilité des résultats ;
- la transparence ;
- la protection des données ;
- les coûts ;
- la consommation de ressources ;
- l'évolution du rôle du contributeur.

Le stagiaire rencontrera les différents acteurs des projets afin d'identifier les besoins et les difficultés rencontrées avec les méthodes actuelles.

About the Role

Based in Paris or Bordeaux, the future Senior Backend Developer will be a key player in our Tech team. Working closely with our Head of Software, you'll help us scale our systems and accelerate our product development. This role is a mix of deep technical ownership, hands-on architecture work, and high-impact feature development.

Inside our Tech team, you'll find five developers working with high agility. We deploy to production daily and release new app builds every week. We manage a wide range of applications (six in total), all built on very solid foundations. Our system handles tens of thousands of trips per day and hundreds of real-time messages per second between our servers and our connected vehicle fleet.

Every developer works on high-impact projects, tackling exciting technical challenges: improving performance, optimising request loads, and laying the groundwork for tomorrow's more complex features. We're building for scale, preparing to absorb 10 times more users and trips in the coming months, so we are looking for someone who is curious, sharp, and deeply technical with the desire to take ownership and work across a wide range of backend topics.

Key Responsibilities

- Feature development: Build new product features and contribute to the technical roadmap, designing solutions that balance user needs with strong technical foundations.

- Infrastructure maintenance & improvement: Maintain existing systems, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve backend services.

- Performance optimisation: Reduce recurring incidents, improve capacity planning, and optimise backend architecture to ensure scalability and reliability.

- Complex problem-solving: Take ownership of deep technical challenges to ensure the robustness and quality of our platform.

Profile

- Experience: 5+ years in software development, ideally in R&D environments or within product-driven tech teams.

- Tech stack: Strong background in Python; familiarity with Node.js or Go is a plus.

- Problem-solving mindset: You approach problems with pragmatism, balancing quick wins with long-term solutions that scale.

- Ownership & impact: You care about building the right thing, and building it right. You take full responsibility for your work and its impact on users and the product.

- Communication: You express complex ideas clearly, both in writing and verbally, and adapt your messaging to your audience, whether technical or not.

- High standards: Obsessed with clarity in code, in architecture, and in how things fit together, you bring strong opinions backed by experience.

- Bonus (optional): Real-time systems - a first experience with high-frequency, low-latency systems and ensuring smooth communication between distributed components / IoT devices.

Hiring Process

- Pre-screening with Head of Software: 15-minute intro video call

- Initial call with HR: 30-minute conversation to align on expectations

- Culture fit test: Short written exercise (10 minutes)

- Case study & Manager interview: Hands-on exercise to assess your technical skills, followed by a discussion with the Head of Software

- Founders meeting: Final conversation with the founders to dive into vision, motivations, and team fit

Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). En mettant la technologie au service des marques et des consommateurs, Numberly est au cœur de la croissance des entreprises et de l’aspiration de chacun à un marketing plus responsable et plus pertinent. Votre Mission

En raison de notre large gamme de produits interconnectés et des activités de nos clients, nos problèmes techniques sont très variés et souvent complexes :

  • traiter des milliers de requêtes par seconde, réparties dans le monde entier
  • exploiter plusieurs bases de données de plusieurs pétaoctets (Big Data™) de manière hautement disponible
  • automatiser l'ensemble de notre infrastructure bare-metal
  • concevoir les interfaces du marketing digital de demain.

Pour ce faire, nous devons utiliser les bonnes technologies pour les bons cas d'usage :

  • Python 3 pour nos services web, notre ingénierie des données et l'automatisation de notre infrastructure
  • PostgreSQL et MongoDB pour leur polyvalence dans l'utilisation des données
  • ScyllaDB lorsqu'il s'agit d'exigences élevées en matière de débit et de faibles latences
  • GitLab et Kubernetes pour offrir la meilleure expérience développeur possible
  • mais aussi Kafka, Redis, Elasticsearch, Go et bien d'autres...

Qualifications

  • Forte culture IT et curiosité technique
  • Connaissances approfondies dans au moins une stack back-end
  • Bonne maîtrise de Python
  • Intérêt pour les bases de données, le monde de l'open-source et/ou la culture DevOps
  • Bonne capacité à communiquer, capable de vulgariser son travail, de défendre ses idées et d'écouter les autres
  • Volonté de progresser et d'aider les autres à progresser, sur le plan technique (meetups, formations internes) et personnel
  • Une expérience significative avec Python et/ou JavaScript est un plus
  • L'utilisation quotidienne de Linux est très préférable mais non obligatoire
  • Anglais professionnel (nos équipes sont internationales)
  • Forte appétence pour l’IA et l’automatisation, pratique régulière des LLMs et bonne compréhension des architectures agentiques/multi-agents.
  • Expérience dans la conception et la mise en place d’agents, création de skills, codage de MCP et compréhension des intégrations via APIs.

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team

To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team. This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking.
  • Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.
  • Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients.
  • Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers.
  • Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management.
  • Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling.
  • Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community.

You Will Collaborate Cross-functionally With

  • The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations.
  • The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody.
  • The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs.
  • The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming.
  • The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability.
  • The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation.
  • The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of backend engineering, with real production ownership of distributed systems.
  • Strong production experience
  • Interest for Scala and functional programming practice
  • Hands-on blockchain integration experience: transaction lifecycle, fees, finality, reorgs, on at least two models among account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.
  • Experience with event-driven systems and data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, NATS or equivalent) and with observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent).
  • Able to diagnose an incident across several services and own the outcome, from root cause to fix in production.
  • Comfortable reading and contributing to TypeScript code, as the team works on a polyglot stack.
  • Daily use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.
  • Clear written communication in English, especially for design documents and incident reports.

Benefits

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week
  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.
  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.
  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.
  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your Team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As a Senior Full-stack Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will take a leading role in building and scaling Nabla’s AI-powered healthcare platform. You will work across the stack—from back-end services to web, desktop, and mobile apps—and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Machine Learning teams to deliver high-impact features that directly serve healthcare professionals.

You Will

  • Lead the design and development of new product features across web, mobile, and desktop platforms
  • Architect and optimize back-end APIs and services to support complex product needs
  • Drive cross-functional projects from idea to production, collaborating closely with Product, ML, and Design teams
  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the organization
  • Contribute to architecture discussions, technical strategy, and best practices
  • Proactively explore and adopt new technologies to keep our stack efficient and scalable

To Give You a Sense Of The Impact

  • Nabla processes 10 billion tokens/month with LLMs
  • Every week, hundreds of thousands of clinical notes are automatically generated and synced with EHRs, saving thousands of hours for clinicians
  • Our applications support healthcare professionals in real-time, high-stakes clinical environments

Your DNA

  • You have 5+ years of industry experience in full-stack or software engineering roles
  • You have strong foundations in computer science or a related discipline
  • You’re proficient in both back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, Go, C++, Python, etc.) and front-end frameworks (React, Vue, etc.)
  • You have experience leading complex projects across the stack and collaborating across multiple teams
  • You write clean, maintainable code and have high standards for software quality
  • You are comfortable driving architectural decisions and mentoring other engineers
  • You communicate clearly in English
  • Bonus: experience with a native applications language (Swift, Kotlin, Rust, C#, etc)

Our stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Swift, Rust, Electron.
  • Backend: Kotlin / JVM, GraphQL, PostgreSQL.
  • ML & Infra: Python, PyTorch, Slurm, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes.

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers). Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here Are The Benefits You Get When Joining Nabla

  • Stock ownership
  • 100% healthcare coverage
  • Meal vouchers
  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%
  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT
  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare
  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Committed to diversity

Diversity & Inclusion

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Our applications have become the tool of choice for more than 50 clients across more than 10 countries worldwide, from passenger transport operators such as SNCF, Transavia, VIA Rail Canada and Eurostar to sports clubs such as PSG, Angers SCO and FC Sochaux, to manage their inventory, sell tickets across every channel, and optimize their pricing on a daily basis.

Your missions

You'll join CAYZN, our advanced Revenue Management Solution for the transportation industry, helping our clients optimize their capacity with dynamic pricing. What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.
